subject: Hosted API commit range & peak TPS sanity check
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Claudia Ruiz <claudia@novumhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: hosted API commit range & peak TPS (post-demo)

Hi Claudia — thanks again for a productive call this morning. Quick recap and a few clarifying asks so we can put a firm pricing proposal together: 

Recap of what you said on the call:
- Primary integration: automated triage + patient-facing chat (tiered prompts, 512–2,048 token windows).
- Expected launch: pilot with internal users in Q1, broader production H2 next year.
- Important: PHI flows are limited to metadata; main model calls are for summarization and question-answering (no attachments in model prompt).

What we need from you (short answers are fine):
1) Monthly token volume (best guess): please provide a low/base/high range for the first 12 months. If you prefer example buckets (e.g., 1–10M, 10–50M, 50–200M) that works.
2) Peak TPS expectations: what does a realistic burst look like? (sustained TPS for 10s/1m and an absolute burst cap)
3) Budget guidance: is there a $/1M token target or range you need us to respect for procurement?
4) Commitment horizon: are you thinking month-to-month for pilot, or do you want a 6–12 month reserved band post-pilot?

I attached the small traffic-profile CSV template we mentioned — fill the monthly columns and send back if it’s easier than listing numbers inline.

Next steps: if you can send the numbers today/tomorrow we’ll return a tailored pricing band + concurrency proposal (including suggested burst limits and fallback model variants) by EOD Monday.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive — Hosted API
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0198

Attachment: novum-poc-traffic-profile.csv (CSV template: month, avg_tokens, peak_10s_tps, peak_1m_tps)
From: Claudia Ruiz <claudia@novumhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-14T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: hosted API commit range & peak TPS (post-demo)

Jordan — thanks, the template helped. Numbers below are our internal best estimates for the pilot + 12 months of ramp. These include both prompt + completion tokens (we counted both).

Monthly token volume (low / base / high):
- Low (pilot): ~8,000,000 tokens/month
- Base (first 6 months post-pilot): ~25,000,000 tokens/month
- High (12-month ramp / full prod): ~125,000,000 tokens/month

Peak TPS:
- Typical sustained peak (10s window): 85 TPS
- Short 1m sustained spike: 120 TPS (30–90s windows)
- Absolute burst (rare): up to 260 TPS for <30s during major campaign bursts

Budget target: procurement has a ballpark target of ~$60 per 1M tokens for hosted API calls (they asked me to push for <$50 if possible but $60 is our internal comfort threshold).

Commitment horizon: pilot will be month-to-month. After pilot, likely a 12-month reserved band if economics are right.

Let me know if you need tokenization samples — we tokenized a representative month and attached it as a CSV row in the template.

— Claudia
Claudia Ruiz
Head of Product Operations
Novum Health
claudia@novumhealth.com

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-14T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: hosted API commit range & peak TPS (post-demo)

Thanks Claudia — this is exactly what we needed. A few clarifying notes and how we’ll proceed: 

Clarifications:
- Tokens: we counted both prompt+completion, which matches your CSV — that’s perfect.
- Bursts: we can support the 120 TPS 1m spike comfortably on hosted if we size the pool correctly; the 260 TPS absolute burst will require short-term burst capacity (and may trigger a higher unit price during the burst window).

Preliminary commercial guidance (subject to final turn-key pricing):
- Pilot band (month-to-month): 8M tokens @ $85 per 1M (short-term, zero-commit discount not applied) — includes best-effort concurrency up to 100 TPS.
- Ramp band (expected base 25M/month): propose a reserved band at $60 per 1M with a soft SLA for 120 TPS sustained (with burst credits).
- Production band (125M/month): negotiation needed — we can propose $45–55 per 1M depending on commitment length (12 vs 24 months) and peak TPS guarantees.

Next steps I’ll take now:
1) Marissa will draft a short pricing proposal PDF with two band options and explicit burst policy (we’ll attach).
2) I’ll include recommended concurrency controls and a canary policy to keep costs predictable during ramp.
3) If Novum can commit to a 12-month band after pilot we can lock the $60 / 1M pricing for the base band.

Marissa — looping you in to finalize the pricing draft and suggested SLA/burst language. Claudia — if the bands above are directionally okay I’ll have Marissa send the draft proposal and a sample SOW you can share with procurement.

Best,
Jordan
Account Executive — Hosted API
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Claudia Ruiz <claudia@novumhealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-15T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Pricing proposal draft and next steps

Claudia / Jordan — attaching a short draft (redwood-pricing-proposal-draft.pdf) summarizing the bands Jordan outlined and the burst policy. Key items in the draft: 

1) Pilot (month-to-month)
- Band: up to 10M tokens/month
- Unit price: $80 / 1M tokens
- Concurrency: best-effort up to 100 TPS; excess traffic charged at on-demand burst rate

2) Ramp (recommended reserve)
- Band: 25M tokens/month (12-month term)
- Unit price: $60 / 1M tokens (commits priced at this band; overages billed at +20% above band price)
- SLA: soft concurrency guarantee to support sustained 120 TPS; burst credits included for 3 events/month up to 150% of baseline TPS for up to 2 min/event

3) Production (negotiable)
- Band: 125M tokens/month (12–24 month term)
- Indicative unit price: $50 / 1M tokens with tighter SLA and dedicated reserved pool for peak TPS (final price contingent on confirmed peak provisioning windows)

Actions for Novum to move forward:
- Confirm which band you expect to commit to after pilot (pilot/pilot+12m ramp/prod).
- If procurement needs a PO or draft SOW we can generate that once you confirm band and term.
- I can also add an explicit billing carve-out for burst usage if you prefer a separate burst budget.

Claudia — is procurement okay with the $60 / 1M target for a 12-month ramp? If not, tell us target $/1M and we’ll attempt to trade on term or committed peak TPS.

Thanks — attaching the draft now.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Pricing & Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
